# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not report security vulnerabilities, exploits, or cheats in a public GitHub issue or pull request.

Report them privately by email to **[security@cnc-online.net](mailto:security@cnc-online.net)**. Include enough detail for the team to reproduce and assess the issue: the Tacitus version, a clear description, reproduction steps, and any proof of impact. Do not share credentials, access tokens, or other sensitive information unless the team explicitly asks for them through a secure channel.

The team will acknowledge the report, investigate it privately, and coordinate any follow-up or disclosure as appropriate.

## Scope

This policy covers security issues affecting the Tacitus client. General bugs, feature requests, and feedback belong in this repository's public issue forms.
